claims.statement: Attention policy connects incomplete-tour endpoints with fragment demands and statuses.
Single-instance annealing and batch improving-only search use fixed trained operators, not active-search fine-tuning.
Four models per class/group, 250000 batches of 256, V100 and ten CPU cores.
Batch times in Table 1 cover 10000 instances; imported RL-BS times are scaled tenfold.
NLNS beats LKH3 mean cost in 11/17 groups but UHGS wins all; split-delivery gains occur on 100-customer cases.
Separate distribution/operator-specific CVRP and SDVRP models revise incumbents; specialist improvement classification.
